#BREAKING 

ICMR detects 2 cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in #Karnataka 

A 3-month-old girl and 8-month-old male infant diagnosed with bronchopneumonia at Bengaluru’s #BaptistHospital. Both are recovering.

No travel history, no unusual surge in ILI/SARI cases.
